close_proposal_on_execution_failure.description:
This field was not present in DAO DAO v1. To migrate, a
value must be specified.

If set to true proposals will be closed if their execution
fails. Otherwise, proposals will remain open after execution
failure. For example, with this enabled a proposal to send 5
tokens out of a DAO's treasury with 4 tokens would be closed when
it is executed. With this disabled, that same proposal would
remain open until the DAO's treasury was large enough for it to be
executed.

pre_propose_info.description:
This field was not present in DAO DAO v1. To migrate, a
value must be specified.

This contains information about how a pre-propose module may be configured.
If set to "AnyoneMayPropose", there will be no pre-propose module and consequently,
no deposit or membership checks when submitting a proposal. The "ModuleMayPropose"
option allows for instantiating a prepropose module which will handle deposit verification and return logic.

veto.description:
This field was not present in DAO DAO v1. To migrate, a
value must be specified.

optional configuration for veto feature

anyone_may_propose.description: Anyone may create a proposal free of charge.

module_may_propose.description:
The module specified in INFO has exclusive rights to proposal
creation.

definitions.name: dao_interface_state_ModuleInstantiateInfo
definitions.description: Information needed to instantiate a module.

admin.description:
CosmWasm level admin of the instantiated contract. See:
<https://docs.cosmwasm.com/docs/1.0/smart-contracts/migration>

code_id.description: Code ID of the contract to be instantiated.

funds.description: Funds to be sent to the instantiated contract.

salt.description:
Salt to use with instantiate2, if defined. Otherwise uses normal
instantiate.

definitions.name: cosmwasm_std_binary_Binary
definitions.description:
Binary is a wrapper around Vec<u8> to add base64 de/serialization
with serde. It also adds some helper methods to help encode inline.

This is only needed as serde-json-{core,wasm} has a horrible encoding for Vec<u8>.
See also <https://github.com/CosmWasm/cosmwasm/blob/main/docs/MESSAGE_TYPES.md>.

definitions.name: dao_interface_state_Admin
definitions.description:
Information about the CosmWasm level admin of a contract. Used in
conjunction with `ModuleInstantiateInfo` to instantiate modules.

address.description: Set the admin to a specified address.

core_module.description: Sets the admin as the core module address.

definitions.name: cosmwasm_std_math_uint256_Uint256

early_execute.description:
Whether or not the vetoer can execute a proposal early before the
timelock duration has expired

timelock_duration.description:
The time duration to lock a proposal for after its expiration to allow
the vetoer to veto.

veto_before_passed.description: Whether or not the vetoer can veto a proposal before it passes.

vetoer.description: The address able to veto proposals.

definitions.name: cw_utils_expiration_Duration
definitions.description:
Duration is a delta of time. You can add it to a BlockInfo or Expiration to
move that further in the future. Note that an height-based Duration and
a time-based Expiration cannot be combined
